name: Single-serve Potato Chips (Salted)
descriptions: A 50g sealed bag of thin, crispy salted potato chips — classic snack crunch.
Ready-to-eat, long shelf life, perfect for movie nights or quick munching.
effects: Instant crunchy satisfaction; temporarily quiets salty cravings.
Tastes best fresh and encourages reaching for another handful.

name: Classic Cola Can (330ml)
descriptions: A chilled 330ml can of cola — fizzy, sweet, caffeinated soda.
Ready to drink straight from the can; gives a quick sugar-and-caffeine pick-me-up.
effects: Carbonation gives a refreshing bite; sugar and caffeine create a quick energy spike.
May make you feel slightly more alert for a short time.

name: Assorted Chocolate Bar
descriptions: A 50g chocolate bar with creamy milk chocolate and crunchy bits.
Individually wrapped, sweet and rich — great for a quick treat or dessert.
effects: Immediate mood lift from sugar and cocoa; a brief moment of indulgence.
Melts pleasantly in the mouth, leaving a lingering sweetness.

name: Mixed Candy Pouch
descriptions: A resealable 200g pouch of mixed sweets (hard candies, gummies, and chews).
Brightly flavored and great for sharing or snacking over time.
effects: Satisfies a strong sweet tooth; quick bursts of sugary flavor.
Chewy pieces provide a longer-lasting snack experience.

name: Mini Chocolate Truffle Box (6 pcs)
descriptions: A small boxed selection of six soft-center chocolate truffles.
Rich, bite-sized luxury chocolates ideal for a special treat.
effects: Decadent flavor gives a pleasant indulgent sensation and a brief mood boost.
Best eaten slowly to savor the rich centers.

name: Instant Noodles Cup (Chicken Flavor)
descriptions: Single-serving instant ramen cup: dry noodles and seasoning packet, ready with hot water.
Comfort-food style portion; easy to prepare anywhere with boiling water.
effects: Hearty and warm; filling when prepared with hot water.
High on salt and umami, provides quick comfort but may make you thirsty afterwards.

name: Microwave Mac & Cheese Cup
descriptions: Single-serve cup of dried pasta and cheese sauce powder — requires microwave and a little water.
Creamy, cheesy comfort food classic that's quick to make.
effects: Warm and filling; a comforting, savory snack.
Best eaten hot for maximum creaminess.

name: Energy Drink Can
descriptions: A 250ml energy drink with high caffeine and sugar content for a strong boost.
Sharp, tangy taste; not recommended as a regular hydration source.
effects: Powerful, fast energy surge and increased alertness for a short period.
May cause jitteriness if consumed in excess.

name: Sweet Breakfast Cereal (Snack Box)
descriptions: A small snack-sized box of sweetened grain cereal — can be eaten dry as a snack.
Crunchy, sugary flakes often eaten with milk but equally tasty alone.
effects: Crunchy and sweet; satisfying for morning cravings or as a dry snack.
Provides steady carbs and a quick source of sugar.

name: Sugar Cookies
descriptions: A  wrapped sugar cookie.
Soft, buttery cookies with a light sweet glaze — great with a soda or coffee.
effects: Comforting, sweet treat that pairs well with warm or cold drinks.
Slows down hunger pangs and satisfies dessert cravings.

name: Chocolate-Covered Peanuts Snack Pack
descriptions: A small resealable pouch of chocolate-covered peanuts — crunchy nut center, sweet shell.
Combines protein and sugar for a snack that's both satisfying and indulgent.
effects: Crunchy, slightly salty nuts coated in chocolate deliver a balanced sweet-salty bite.
Good for a quick nibble or sharing.
